ARABIC — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

4. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

5. When practising Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Fluency.

6. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Fluency: Pronunciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud: Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information: Visuals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive Reading: Library Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing: Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Guided writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
